name: Feature or device proposal
about: Propose a focused improvement or a new hardware target

---

## User need

What workflow would this improve?

## Proposed scope

Describe the smallest useful change and how it fits the roadmap.

## Validation

What would demonstrate that it works? For a new device, include its model and
non-identifying controller/descriptor information, and say whether physical
hardware is available. Do not infer support from another machine's results.
